mapper.select: select u.id, u.username, u.password, u.role, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time from `user` u where u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into `user` (username, password, role, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
